profile.headline: Fullstack Developer · Business Process Improvement · eCommerce
profile.summary:
Started in graphic design. Learned to code because I got tired of asking developers to do things I could already see clearly in my head. That was a long time ago. Now I build the whole thing myself.
▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬
My background is a weird mix of creative work, ops management, and systems development. That combination sounds odd on paper and works really well in practice. I understand the business. I understand the stack. I can ship.
▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬
◈ WHAT I DO
Fullstack development for OTC nutraceutical and wellness brands. Storefront architecture, automation pipelines, CRM buildout, internal tooling, and anything else that needs to get done.
▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬
◈ THINGS I HAVE ACTUALLY BUILT
→ Scaled an eCommerce operation from $5.5M to $18M annually through ERP migration, systems design, and operational infrastructure
→ Migrated 5,000+ SKUs, five years of order history, and all customer data from a legacy WordPress/MySQL stack to a custom BigCommerce storefront. Everything worked.
→ Designed and deployed full network infrastructure for a 50,000 sq ft manufacturing facility. Fiber-to-coax backbone, Ubiquiti managed switching, segmented networks, NVR, local servers. No contractors.
→ Multi-channel marketplace expansion across Shopify, Amazon, and Walmart simultaneously. Customers didn't notice the complexity, which is the point.
→ n8n automation chains that run quietly and save hours every week. Twilio SMS alerts, Google Sheets to PDF generation, Klaviyo lifecycle sequences, webhook normalization.
▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬
◈ STACK
TypeScript · JavaScript · Vue.js · PHP · Python · SQL · Bash n8n · Zapier · Klaviyo · REST APIs Proxmox · Docker · Ubiquiti · Linux Figma · Photoshop · Illustrator
▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬
◈ CURRENTLY RESEARCHING
Local LLM deployment. Not trying to replace GPT-4. Trying to figure out how small, purpose-built models can handle single tasks reliably and offline.
Current focus: visual QA, automated unit test generation, competitor research pipelines, and RAG setups with vector databases. Heavy use of Ollama and Open Claw.
Daily driver is Fedora. I run my own server network for side projects. Linux is not a personality trait, it is just the tool that gets out of the way.
▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬
If you are working on something interesting in eCommerce, automation, or systems development, connect.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Fernandina Beach, Florida, United States · Remote
positions.description:
· Architected and built a full-stack web application for interactive visualization of phased array antenna geometries, rendering real-time array factor and beam patterns as engineers adjust element layout, spacing, and steering angle.
· Implemented a configurable suite of amplitude-tapering and windowing methods (Taylor, Chebyshev, Hamming, and custom filters) to demonstrate sidelobe suppression and beam-shaping tradeoffs.
· Designed the platform as a hands-on onboarding and training tool that compresses the ramp-up time for engineers new to phased array systems, replacing static reference material with an explorable, physics accurate sandbox.

positions.title: Ecommerce Developer
positions.description:
· Managed social media channels and print marketing for sales outreach to our 1,200+ retail partners nationwide.
· Optimized the subscription product vertical by introducing new time-based plan options and expanding availability site-wide, increasing eCommerce revenue by 30% in year one.
· Full-scale redesigns of eCommerce sites Workman's Relief & Crafty, optimizing performance, & conversions.
· Architected and launched a new contract manufacturing brand (OrganicMFG.com) from the ground up - establishing CMS, sales funnel, rep onboarding via Apollo, and internal SOPs.

positions.title: Ecommerce Operations Manager
positions.locationName: Daytona Beach, Florida, United States · On-site
positions.description:
· Led all technical infrastructure buildout for a new 50,000 sq ft manufacturing facility, personally designing and deploying the full network architecture including fiber-to-coax backbone, Ubiquiti managed switching, segmented eCommerce and production networks, wireless endpoints, structured data drops, and equipment connectivity from the ground up.
· Deployed local Windows servers for fulfillment logistics and a dedicated NVR for a 24/7 facility-wide surveillance system.
· Migrated the business into enterprise-level operational systems (ERP), scaling revenue from $5.5M to $18M annually.
